consequence.statement: When running with --namespace=<namespace>, cert-manager now limits its scope to a single namespace and disables cluster-scoped controllers, whereas previously the flag did not behave correctly.

original.statement: The --namespace CLI flag behavior is fixed to properly limit cert-manager scope to a single namespace and disable cluster-scoped controllers.

decision.reason: [ev-ef5237d47ade] lists this under "Bug or Regression". It says that running with `--namespace=<namespace>` now limits cert-manager to that single namespace and disables cluster-scoped controllers. The note does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. It only describes a corrected runtime behavior that an operator should check, so behavior-change (review) fits and no failure kind is supported.
